questions.title: Routh Array
questions.stem: Assertion (A): Routh criterion is in terms of array formulation which is more convenient to handle.Reason (R): This method is used to investigate the method of stability of higher order systems.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.quick: Both statements are true: the Routh criterion converts a characteristic polynomial into an algebraic array and is especially convenient for determining the number of right-half-plane roots of higher-order systems without explicitly solving for all roots. However, the second statement is a use of the method rather than the precise reason the array formulation is convenient, so the final-key choice is B.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Routh-Hurwitz stability analysis uses polynomial coefficients to build the Routh table. Changes of sign in the first column equal the number of roots in the right-half s-plane. It scales well to higher-order characteristic equations compared with direct root calculation, while also handling special zero-row/zero-first-element cases with standard procedures.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Routh table → stability without solving all roots.

**Important Exam Point**

In assertion-reason questions, distinguish 'both true' from 'R explains A'.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Control Systems → Stability → Routh-Hurwitz Criterion .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Routh table → stability without solving all roots.

### Common Mistake

Assuming higher-order applicability alone logically explains why array handling is convenient.

### Exam Tip

In assertion-reason questions, distinguish 'both true' from 'R explains A'.

questions.title: Direct Lyapunov Method
questions.stem: The method of investigating the stability using Liapunov function is _____________
questions.quick: Investigating stability by constructing a Lyapunov function V(x) and examining its derivative along system trajectories is called Lyapunov's direct (second) method. It avoids explicitly solving the nonlinear differential equations.
formula: V̇(x)<0 ⇒ asymptotic stability (standard local/global conditions apply)
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

A suitable Lyapunov function is positive definite near the equilibrium and its time derivative is negative definite for asymptotic stability (with standard qualifications). The indirect method instead linearizes the system near an equilibrium and inspects the linearized eigenvalues.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Lyapunov function itself → direct method.

**Important Exam Point**

Indirect method = linearization/eigenvalues.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Control Systems → Nonlinear Control → Lyapunov Stability .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Lyapunov function itself → direct method.

### Common Mistake

Calling it indirect merely because V̇ is computed indirectly from dynamics.

### Exam Tip

Indirect method = linearization/eigenvalues.

questions.title: Type of Unity-Feedback System
questions.stem: For a unity feedback system, the open loop transfer function is G(s) = K(s + 2)/s² (s² + 7s + 12). What is the type of system?
questions.quick: System type equals the number of pure integrators (poles at the origin) in the open-loop transfer function G(s)H(s). Here the denominator contains s², so there are two poles at the origin and the system is Type 2.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Finite poles such as roots of s²+7s+12=(s+3)(s+4) do not affect system type. Likewise the zero at −2 does not reduce the count unless it exactly cancels a pole at the origin, which it does not. Type determines steady-state error constants for step, ramp and parabolic inputs.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Count uncancelled poles at the origin only.

**Important Exam Point**

Do not count total denominator order.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Control Systems → Steady-State Error → System Type .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Count uncancelled poles at the origin only.

### Common Mistake

Calling it Type 4 because the overall denominator is fourth order.

### Exam Tip

Do not count total denominator order.

questions.title: Autocorrelation of Rectangular Pulse
questions.stem: The auto-correlation function of a rectangular pulse of duration T is
options: A rectangular pulse of duration T
A triangular pulse of duration T
questions.quick: The autocorrelation of a rectangular pulse is triangular. As one pulse slides across the other, their overlap length decreases linearly with shift; for an original pulse duration T, nonzero overlap exists from −T to +T, giving total triangular duration 2T.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Autocorrelation R_xx(τ)=∫x(t)x(t+τ)dt. For a unit rectangular pulse of width T, the integrand is 1 only in the overlap region. The overlap length is T−|τ| for |τ|≤T and zero outside. Hence R_xx(τ) is a triangle centered at τ=0.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Rectangle autocorrelation → triangle twice as wide.

**Important Exam Point**

Autocorrelation is maximum at zero shift.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Control Systems → Signals and Systems → Correlation .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Rectangle autocorrelation → triangle twice as wide.

### Common Mistake

Choosing a rectangular result because the original signal is rectangular.

### Exam Tip

Autocorrelation is maximum at zero shift.

questions.title: Unity-Feedback Step Response
questions.stem: What is the response of the feedback function with open loop transfer function G(s) = 4/s(s + 5) and input is input step?
questions.quick: For unity feedback, first form T(s)=G(s)/(1+G(s)), then multiply by the step input 1/s and perform partial fractions. For G(s)=4/[s(s+5)], the closed-loop denominator is s²+5s+4=(s+1)(s+4), giving the response 1−(1/3)(4e⁻ᵗ−e⁻⁴ᵗ).
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The closed-loop transfer function is 4/[s(s+5)+4]=4/[(s+1)(s+4)]. For a unit step, C(s)=4/[s(s+1)(s+4)]. Partial-fraction expansion gives 1/s−(4/3)/(s+1)+(1/3)/(s+4). Taking the inverse Laplace transform produces the keyed result.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Unity feedback: close the loop before applying the input.

**Important Exam Point**

Check c(0⁺)=0 and c(∞)=1 as quick validation.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Control Systems → Time Response → Closed-Loop Step Response .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Unity feedback: close the loop before applying the input.

### Common Mistake

Using open-loop G(s) directly as the step-response transfer function.

### Exam Tip

Check c(0⁺)=0 and c(∞)=1 as quick validation.

questions.title: Gain Change for Specified Overshoot
questions.stem: The open loop transfer function for a unit feedback system is G(s) = K/s(sT + 1). By what factor the amplitude gain K should be reduced so that the peak overshoot becomes 25% from 75%?
questions.quick: Percent overshoot fixes the damping ratio through M_p=e^{−πζ/√(1−ζ²)}. For G(s)=K/[s(sT+1)], the closed-loop damping ratio varies inversely with √K. Converting 75% and 25% overshoot to ζ values and squaring their ratio gives the required gain reduction factor, matching 20.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The closed-loop characteristic equation is Ts²+s+K=0. In standard form s²+2ζω_ns+ω_n²=0, giving ω_n²=K/T and 2ζω_n=1/T, so ζ=1/(2√(KT)). Therefore K∝1/ζ² for fixed T. Determine ζ from each overshoot and use K_new/K_old=(ζ_old/ζ_new)². The strong drop in overshoot requires a substantial reduction in K.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Overshoot → ζ first; then use ζ∝1/√K.

**Important Exam Point**

Use M_p as decimal (0.75, 0.25), not percentage numbers 75 and 25.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Control Systems → Transient Response → Second-Order Systems .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Overshoot → ζ first; then use ζ∝1/√K.

### Common Mistake

Assuming overshoot is directly proportional to gain.

### Exam Tip

Use M_p as decimal (0.75, 0.25), not percentage numbers 75 and 25.

RST number × 8 → hexadecimal vector address.

questions.quick: A controller processes the error/control information and modifies the control signal so the plant responds according to desired performance requirements. It may amplify, integrate, differentiate, shape or otherwise compensate the signal.

In a feedback loop, the comparator forms error between reference and measured output. Its purpose is not merely to receive or transmit a signal; it deliberately shapes system behavior.

questions.title: DAA Instruction
questions.stem: DAA instruction is used to perform which type of addition?
questions.quick: DAA (Decimal Adjust Accumulator) is used after adding packed BCD numbers so the binary result in the accumulator is corrected to a valid BCD representation. Hence it is associated with BCD addition.
formula: If low nibble >9 or AC=1 → add 06H
If high nibble >9 or CY=1 → add 60H
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The processor performs ordinary binary addition first. DAA then examines the lower nibble/auxiliary carry and upper nibble/carry and conditionally adds 06H and/or 60H. This produces a valid two-digit packed BCD result.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

DAA = Decimal Adjust after Addition.

**Important Exam Point**

DAA does not itself perform decimal addition; it corrects the accumulator after binary addition.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Microprocessors and Interfacing → 8085 Microprocessor → Instructions .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

DAA = Decimal Adjust after Addition.

### Common Mistake

Selecting binary addition because the ALU initially adds in binary.

### Exam Tip

DAA does not itself perform decimal addition; it corrects the accumulator after binary addition.

options: Input port is loaded into input latches
Input port is loaded into output latches
Output port is loaded into input latches
Output port is loaded into output latches
questions.quick: In strobed input operation, a LOW pulse on STB̅ tells the 8255 that valid peripheral data is present and causes the input port data to be loaded into the input latch. The corresponding buffer-full/status logic is then updated.
formula: STB̅ LOW → input data latched → IBF set (per mode timing)

STB̅ is an active-low peripheral handshake signal in Mode 1 input. Its falling/low action captures input data so the CPU can later read a stable latched value. Output latches are associated with output-mode handshake signals such as OBF̅, not with the STB̅ input event.

STB = strobe input → input latch.

Active-low notation means LOW is the asserted condition.

questions.quick: In Mode 2 (rate generator), after N counts the output produces a LOW pulse lasting exactly one input clock period, then automatically reloads and repeats. Thus the LOW interval is one clock cycle.

Mode 2 behaves like a divide-by-N periodic rate generator. OUT is normally HIGH. When the count reaches 1/terminal event, OUT goes LOW for one clock and then returns HIGH as the count reloads. This makes it useful for periodic interrupt or baud-rate generation.

8253/8254 Mode 2 → one-clock LOW pulse every N clocks.

questions.quick: JNZ tests the zero flag and branches when Z=0. The timing depends on whether the jump is taken; under the processor/timing convention intended by this question, when the 'zero condition' is satisfied the execution path takes four clock cycles, matching the final key.

### Concept & Reasoning

Conditional-branch timing must be read together with the exact processor architecture because 8085, 8086 and later x86 devices use different timing units and instruction encodings. The conceptual rule remains: JNZ means 'jump if not zero', so Z=1 means the branch condition is false; only the fall-through path executes. The official answer should be retained with that timing convention.

Decode the flag condition before recalling cycle counts.

questions.quick: A usable 8086 stack requires both SS (Stack Segment) and SP (Stack Pointer) to be initialized. SS identifies the stack segment base and SP gives the offset of the current top of stack.

### Concept & Reasoning

Physical stack addresses are formed from SS:SP. PUSH, POP, CALL, RET and interrupt operations automatically update SP, usually by two bytes for 16-bit words. If either SS or SP is undefined, stack accesses may go to an unintended memory location.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Stack address always think SS:SP pair.

Initialize SS and SP coherently before enabling operations that may use the stack.

Stack address always think SS:SP pair.

### Common Mistake

Initializing only SS and assuming SP automatically points to a valid stack top.

### Exam Tip

Initialize SS and SP coherently before enabling operations that may use the stack.

questions.title: LOCK Priority
questions.stem: The highest priority usage than any other usage is
options: Data transfer performed by EU (execution unit)
questions.quick: A bus transfer protected by the active-low LOCK̅ signal has highest priority because the processor is explicitly preventing other bus masters from taking control during an indivisible/critical bus operation.
formula: LOCK̅ asserted → bus ownership retained for critical operation
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

LOCK̅ is used around atomic sequences so shared data cannot be interrupted by another bus master. HOLD requests and coprocessor/data-transfer needs must wait until the locked bus operation completes. This preserves consistency for critical read-modify-write sequences.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

LOCK means atomic bus ownership.

**Important Exam Point**

Priority here is about bus usage/arbitration, not interrupt priority.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Microprocessors and Interfacing → 8086/80286 Bus → Bus Arbitration .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

LOCK means atomic bus ownership.

### Common Mistake

Choosing HOLD as highest priority even while a locked transfer is active.

### Exam Tip

Priority here is about bus usage/arbitration, not interrupt priority.

Cascaded 8259A systems use interrupt-acknowledge bus cycles to identify the requesting level and supply the vector information. Keep cascade delay in mind when counting idle states.

questions.title: Degrees of Freedom in LCC HVDC
questions.stem: HVDC LCCs have ______________
questions.quick: A line-commutated converter is fundamentally controlled through its firing angle, giving one principal control degree of freedom per converter bridge for steady-state DC voltage/current regulation. Unlike VSC converters, an LCC cannot independently control active and reactive power.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

In a thyristor LCC, turn-on is controlled by firing delay angle α, while turn-off relies on the AC system commutation voltage. Changing α changes average DC voltage and consequently DC current/power through the link control hierarchy. Reactive power consumption is coupled to active power and firing angle, which is why the converter is described as having one main steady-state control degree of freedom.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

LCC → firing angle control; VSC → more independent P/Q control.

**Important Exam Point**

Keep converter technology in mind before answering 'degrees of freedom'.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power System → HVDC Transmission → Line-Commutated Converters .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

LCC → firing angle control; VSC → more independent P/Q control.

### Common Mistake

Assigning two independent P and Q controls to a thyristor LCC as if it were a VSC.

### Exam Tip

Keep converter technology in mind before answering 'degrees of freedom'.

questions.title: XLPE Cable Insulation
questions.stem: Which insulating material is commonly used in high voltage cables?
questions.quick: XLPE is widely used as insulation in modern medium- and high-voltage power cables because cross-linking improves thermal capability, dielectric performance and mechanical stability compared with ordinary polyethylene/PVC.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Cross-linked polyethylene has high dielectric strength, low dielectric loss and good moisture/chemical resistance, while its cross-linked molecular structure permits higher operating temperature than thermoplastic polyethylene. PVC is common in lower-voltage applications but is not the preferred main insulation for modern HV cables.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Modern HV/EHV extruded cable insulation → XLPE.

**Important Exam Point**

Do not confuse outer sheath/jacket material with primary high-voltage insulation.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power System → High Voltage Engineering → Power Cables .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Modern HV/EHV extruded cable insulation → XLPE.

### Common Mistake

Selecting PVC because it is common in domestic wiring.

### Exam Tip

Do not confuse outer sheath/jacket material with primary high-voltage insulation.

questions.title: Thyristor Valves in LCC HVDC
questions.stem: Efficient LCC HVDC converters generally use __________
questions.quick: Modern efficient line-commutated HVDC converters use series-connected high-power thyristor valves. Thyristors can be triggered at a controlled firing angle and naturally commutate off using the AC system voltage.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Early HVDC schemes used mercury-arc valves, but semiconductor thyristor valves became the standard LCC technology because of improved reliability, controllability and maintainability. Diodes cannot provide firing-angle control, while mechanical switches are far too slow for power-frequency conversion.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

LCC literally points to line-commutated thyristors.

**Important Exam Point**

Distinguish LCC thyristors from self-commutated IGBT-based VSC technology.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power System → HVDC Transmission → Line-Commutated Converters .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

LCC literally points to line-commutated thyristors.

### Common Mistake

Choosing mercury valves because they were historically used in early HVDC links.

### Exam Tip

Distinguish LCC thyristors from self-commutated IGBT-based VSC technology.

questions.title: Partial Discharge in Bushings
questions.stem: __________ finds the deterioration or failure due to internal discharges caused in the insulation of bushing.
questions.quick: Internal/partial-discharge testing is specifically aimed at detecting deterioration, void activity and localized insulation discharge inside a bushing before it develops into complete breakdown.
formula: PD = localized discharge that does not completely bridge the insulation.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

A bushing experiences high electric stress across solid/liquid insulation interfaces. Voids, delamination or contamination can initiate partial discharges that erode insulation progressively. Measuring PD magnitude and inception/extinction behavior is therefore a sensitive diagnostic for internal insulation condition.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Internal deterioration/voids → partial-discharge test.

**Important Exam Point**

Power-factor/tanδ tests assess bulk dielectric condition; PD is more localized-discharge focused.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power System → High Voltage Engineering → Bushings .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Internal deterioration/voids → partial-discharge test.

### Common Mistake

Selecting visible discharge when the defect is internal.

### Exam Tip

Power-factor/tanδ tests assess bulk dielectric condition; PD is more localized-discharge focused.

questions.title: Voltage Multiplier Sag Reduction
questions.stem: How the sag at higher stages can be reduced in a voltage multiplier circuit?
options: By decreasing the capacitance in the higher stages
By decreasing the capacitance in the lower stages
By increasing the capacitance in the higher stages
By increasing the capacitance in the lower stages
questions.quick: In a Cockcroft-Walton multiplier, voltage sag/ripple becomes more severe toward the higher-output stages because charging currents pass through preceding capacitors. Increasing capacitance in the higher stages is one effective grading measure to reduce the voltage sag there, which is the revised final-key choice C.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

A practical multiplier does not deliver exactly n times the peak input under load. Load current causes charge depletion and voltage drop that accumulate through the ladder. Capacitor grading—using larger capacitance where charge-transfer duty is greater or where sag must be reduced—can flatten the stage voltage distribution. The GPSC final key revised this item from the provisional choice to option C, so the final-key answer should be used.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Sag ∝ 1/C: increase capacitance where sag is excessive.

**Important Exam Point**

Use the official final key rather than the provisional highlight for revised questions.

**Editorial / Answer-Key Note**

The official GPSC final answer key revised the provisional outcome for this question from D to C.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power System → High Voltage Engineering → Impulse/High Voltage Generation .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Sag ∝ 1/C: increase capacitance where sag is excessive.

### Common Mistake

Decreasing capacitance when trying to reduce sag.

### Exam Tip

Use the official final key rather than the provisional highlight for revised questions.

questions.title: Heating-Effect Definition of RMS
questions.stem: RMS value is defined based on which of the following?
questions.quick: RMS value is defined as the DC value that would produce the same heating effect in a given resistance over the same time. That is why RMS—not average or peak—is used for AC equipment voltage/current ratings.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Joule heating is proportional to i²R, so alternating current must be squared before averaging. Taking the square root of the mean square gives an effective value directly comparable with DC for resistive power. For a sine wave, I_rms=I_m/√2.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

RMS = equivalent heating effect.

**Important Exam Point**

Square → mean → root is both the name and the calculation.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Basic Electrical Engineering → AC Fundamentals → RMS Value .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

RMS = equivalent heating effect.

### Common Mistake

Using average AC current, which is zero over a complete symmetrical cycle.

### Exam Tip

Square → mean → root is both the name and the calculation.

questions.title: Annual Average Load
questions.stem: Which of the following represents the annual average load?
questions.quick: Annual average load equals total electrical energy supplied during the year divided by the total hours in that year. Therefore Average Load = annual kWh/(365×24), which is option D.
formula: = Energy supplied in year / Hours in year
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Load is power, whereas kWh is energy. Dividing yearly energy by 8760 hours converts the area under the annual load curve into an equivalent constant average power. The same principle applies to daily or monthly average load using the corresponding number of hours.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Energy ÷ time = average power.

**Important Exam Point**

Match energy period with the same time period in the denominator.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Load Curves and Tariffs → Average Load .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Energy ÷ time = average power.

### Common Mistake

Multiplying a daily average by 365 and calling it annual average without using annual energy.

### Exam Tip

Match energy period with the same time period in the denominator.

questions.title: Energy Stored in Magnetic Field
questions.stem: A physical system of electromechanical energy conversion consists of a stationary part creating a magnetic field with electric energy input, and a moving part giving mechanical energy output. If the movable part is kept fixed, the entire electrical energy input will be _______
options: Divided equally between the magnetic and electric fields
questions.quick: In conventional electromagnetic energy-conversion devices, electrical input establishes magnetic flux in the coupling field, so energy is stored primarily in the magnetic field before being converted into mechanical work and/or returned electrically.
formula: Electrical input = mechanical output + losses + ΔW_field
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Motors, generators, relays and actuators use a magnetic coupling field between stationary and moving parts. The energy balance separates electrical input, mechanical output and change in stored field energy. For magnetically coupled devices, the relevant storage term is magnetic-field energy (or co-energy for convenient force/torque derivation).

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Electromechanical machines → magnetic coupling field.

**Important Exam Point**

Co-energy is a mathematical convenience for force/torque; it is not a different physical storage field.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Electrical Machines → Electromechanical Energy Conversion → Field Energy .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Electromechanical machines → magnetic coupling field.

### Common Mistake

Selecting electric-field energy as the dominant coupling mechanism of ordinary rotating electrical machines.

### Exam Tip

Co-energy is a mathematical convenience for force/torque; it is not a different physical storage field.

questions.title: Cold Reserve
questions.stem: Which of the following is called as cold reserve?
options: Reserve capacity available but not ready for use
Reserve capacity available and ready for use
Generating capacity connected to bus and ready to take load
Capacity in service in excess of peak load
questions.quick: Cold reserve is generating capacity that exists but is not ready for immediate use; it requires startup and synchronization before it can carry load. This contrasts with spinning/hot reserve, which is already running or immediately available.
formula: Spinning reserve → synchronized and quickly available
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Reserve terminology is based on response readiness. Spinning reserve is synchronized and can pick up load quickly. Hot/warm reserve is closer to service. Cold reserve may be shut down and needs substantial startup time. Therefore 'available but not ready for use' is the defining description.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Cold = not running/ready.

**Important Exam Point**

Don't confuse reserve capacity with excess load already being carried.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Power System Operation → Reserve Capacity .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Cold = not running/ready.

### Common Mistake

Selecting 'connected to bus and ready'—that describes spinning reserve.

### Exam Tip

Don't confuse reserve capacity with excess load already being carried.

questions.title: Coal-to-Electricity Energy Chain
questions.stem: In a thermal power station, coal is used for the generation of electricity. How energy changes from one form to another before it is transformed into electrical energy?
options: Heat energy → Mechanical energy → Electrical energy
Heat energy → Electrical energy → Mechanical energy
Mechanical energy → Heat energy → Electrical energy
Electrical energy → Heat energy → Mechanical energy
questions.quick: Coal's chemical energy is released as heat in the boiler; steam carries that thermal energy to the turbine, where it becomes mechanical shaft energy; the generator converts the mechanical energy into electrical energy. Among the listed simplified chains, Heat → Mechanical → Electrical is correct.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

A more complete chain is chemical → thermal → mechanical → electrical. The question begins after coal is used for heat generation, so the option starts at heat energy. Each conversion has losses, which is why plant efficiency is far below 100%.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Boiler heat, turbine motion, generator electricity.

**Important Exam Point**

If the option set omits chemical energy, start from the first listed conversion stage.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Thermal Power Plants → Energy Conversion .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Boiler heat, turbine motion, generator electricity.

### Common Mistake

Putting electrical conversion before the turbine's mechanical stage.

### Exam Tip

If the option set omits chemical energy, start from the first listed conversion stage.

questions.title: Thermal Power Plant Operating Cost
questions.stem: Which of the following has the highest operating cost?
questions.quick: Among the listed conventional choices, a thermal power plant has high operating cost because it continuously consumes large quantities of fuel and requires fuel handling, ash handling, boiler operation and significant maintenance. Hydroelectric/solar plants have very low fuel cost.

Operating cost is different from initial capital cost. Thermal stations can have lower initial cost than large hydro/nuclear projects, but coal/gas/oil fuel expense dominates recurring cost. High recurring fuel requirement → high operating cost.

questions.title: Kinetic Energy vs Momentum
questions.stem: When the momentum of a body is doubled, its kinetic energy ___________
options: Becomes four times its initial kinetic energy
Becomes ten times its kinetic energy
questions.quick: For constant mass, kinetic energy is K=p²/(2m). Doubling momentum therefore multiplies kinetic energy by 2²=4. The GPSC final key revised the provisional answer to option C.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Momentum p=mv and kinetic energy K=½mv². Eliminating v gives K=p²/(2m). This square dependence is the quickest way to compare energy after a momentum change without calculating velocity explicitly.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Momentum ×2 → kinetic energy ×4 for same mass.

**Important Exam Point**

Use final key C; provisional highlighting was revised.

**Editorial / Answer-Key Note**

The official GPSC final answer key revised the provisional outcome for this question from A to C.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Engineering Mechanics → Work and Energy .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Momentum ×2 → kinetic energy ×4 for same mass.

### Common Mistake

Assuming kinetic energy is directly proportional to momentum.

### Exam Tip

Use final key C; provisional highlighting was revised.

questions.title: Boiler Function
questions.stem: What is the primary function of a boiler in a steam power plant?
options: To convert mechanical energy into electrical energy
To increase the pressure of the steam
questions.quick: The boiler's primary function is to transfer heat from fuel/heat source to feedwater and convert the water into high-pressure steam for the turbine.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

A boiler includes heat-transfer surfaces such as economizer, evaporator/water walls, superheater and often reheater. It does not generate electricity directly; the turbine-generator does. Pressure rise is mainly established through the feedwater/boiler system, but the core boiler role is steam generation.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Boiler makes steam; turbine makes shaft power; generator makes electricity.

**Important Exam Point**

Differentiate boiler from feed pump and superheater functions.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Steam Power Plants → Boiler .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Boiler makes steam; turbine makes shaft power; generator makes electricity.

### Common Mistake

Selecting 'increase pressure' as the primary function instead of steam generation.

### Exam Tip

Differentiate boiler from feed pump and superheater functions.

questions.title: Condenser Function
questions.stem: What is the purpose of a condenser in a steam power plant?
options: To convert steam back into water
To increase the temperature of the steam
To control the speed of turbine
questions.quick: The condenser removes latent heat from turbine exhaust steam and converts it back into water (condensate), while maintaining a low exhaust pressure that improves turbine work output.
formula: Steam → condenser heat rejection → liquid condensate
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Condensing exhaust steam closes the Rankine water-steam cycle so condensate can be pumped back to the boiler. A good condenser also creates vacuum/low back pressure at the turbine exhaust and facilitates recovery of high-quality feedwater.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Condenser: steam back to water + low turbine back pressure.

**Important Exam Point**

Cooling water removes heat from steam; it does not mix with condensate in a surface condenser.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Steam Power Plants → Condenser .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Condenser: steam back to water + low turbine back pressure.

### Common Mistake

Confusing condenser with cooling tower—the cooling tower cools circulating cooling water.

### Exam Tip

Cooling water removes heat from steam; it does not mix with condensate in a surface condenser.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a type of fuel used in a steam power plant?
questions.quick: Uranium is not a combustion fuel for a conventional steam power plant; it is nuclear fuel used in a reactor to produce heat through fission. Coal, natural gas and oil can all be burned in thermal/steam plants.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Both conventional fossil thermal plants and nuclear plants ultimately may use steam turbines, but the heat source differs. In a conventional steam power plant, chemical combustion supplies heat. In a nuclear station, a reactor replaces the furnace/boiler combustion heat source.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Steam turbine does not automatically mean 'steam power plant' uses every heat source as fuel.

**Important Exam Point**

Interpret the conventional plant context in the options.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Steam Power Plants → Fuels .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Steam turbine does not automatically mean 'steam power plant' uses every heat source as fuel.

### Common Mistake

Choosing natural gas because combined-cycle plants also use gas turbines; gas can still raise steam in boilers/HRSG systems.

### Exam Tip

Interpret the conventional plant context in the options.

questions.title: Typical Thermal Efficiency
questions.stem: What is the efficiency of a typical steam power plant?
questions.quick: A conventional steam power plant typically converts roughly 30–40% of fuel heat into electrical output, depending on steam conditions, reheat/regeneration and plant technology. The rest is rejected mainly in the condenser and stack.
formula: ηplant = Electrical energy output / Fuel heat input ×100%
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The Rankine cycle is constrained by thermodynamic temperature limits and practical component losses. Modern supercritical units can exceed older subcritical values, but the exam's typical range 30–40% is the appropriate conventional figure among the options.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Conventional steam thermal plant → roughly one-third efficiency.

**Important Exam Point**

Do not confuse boiler efficiency with overall station efficiency.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Steam Power Plants → Efficiency .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Conventional steam thermal plant → roughly one-third efficiency.

### Common Mistake

Choosing 70–80%, which is far beyond typical standalone steam-cycle electrical efficiency.

### Exam Tip

Do not confuse boiler efficiency with overall station efficiency.

questions.title: Energy Yield Ratio
questions.stem: A new renewable energy system is designed to harvest energy from wind. The total energy required to build the system is 240 kJ. The energy yield ratio of the system is 14:3. What will be the total energy provided by the system over its lifetime?
questions.quick: An energy yield ratio of 14:3 means energy delivered : energy invested = 14 : 3. For 240 kJ invested, lifetime energy yield is 240×14/3 = 1120 kJ.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Energy yield ratio compares useful lifetime energy output with embodied/build energy. Treat the ratio as a direct proportion. The result should be greater than the construction energy because the numerator 14 exceeds denominator 3.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Ratio output:input → multiply build energy by 14/3.

**Important Exam Point**

Do a magnitude check: yield must exceed 240 kJ.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Renewable Energy → Energy Payback .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Ratio output:input → multiply build energy by 14/3.

### Common Mistake

Inverting 14:3 and obtaining a value below the energy invested.

### Exam Tip

Do a magnitude check: yield must exceed 240 kJ.

questions.title: Cooling Tower Function
questions.stem: What is the function of a cooling tower in a steam power plant?
options: To cool down the water from the condenser
To control the pressure of the steam
questions.quick: A cooling tower rejects waste heat from the condenser cooling-water circuit to the atmosphere, lowering the water temperature so it can be recirculated through the condenser.
formula: Turbine exhaust steam → condenser → heat to cooling water
Warm cooling water → cooling tower → heat to atmosphere
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The condenser transfers heat from exhaust steam to circulating cooling water. The cooling tower then cools that warmed water mainly by evaporative heat and mass transfer. Thus the condenser and cooling tower form two distinct stages of heat rejection.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Condenser cools/condenses steam; cooling tower cools condenser water.

**Important Exam Point**

Track which fluid each component acts on.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Power Plant Engineering → Steam Power Plants → Cooling System .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Condenser cools/condenses steam; cooling tower cools condenser water.

### Common Mistake

Calling the cooling tower a device that directly condenses turbine exhaust steam.

### Exam Tip

Track which fluid each component acts on.

questions.title: Global Temperature Goal
questions.stem: What is the aim of Paris Agreement in 2015? (Note : C indicates Celsius)
options: To keep the decrease in global average temperature to below 2 degree C
To keep the decrease in global average temperature to above 2 degree C
To keep the increase in global average temperature to above 2 degree C
To keep the increase in global average temperature to below 2 degree C
questions.quick: The Paris Agreement aims to hold the increase in global average temperature well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels and pursue efforts to limit the increase to 1.5°C. Therefore the correct direction is to keep the increase below the stated threshold, not a decrease in temperature.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The agreement's temperature objective concerns limiting anthropogenic warming relative to pre-industrial conditions. It does not promise that global average temperature will fall; it seeks to constrain the magnitude of further increase through nationally determined contributions and progressively stronger climate action.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Paris = limit the increase, not cause a temperature decrease.

**Important Exam Point**

Watch sign/direction words: increase vs decrease, above vs below.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Energy and Environment → Climate Policy → Paris Agreement .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Paris = limit the increase, not cause a temperature decrease.

### Common Mistake

Choosing an option describing a decrease in global average temperature.

### Exam Tip

Watch sign/direction words: increase vs decrease, above vs below.

questions.title: Solar Declination at Summer Solstice
questions.stem: What is Sun’s declination angle during summer solstice?
questions.quick: At the Northern Hemisphere summer solstice, the Sun's declination reaches approximately +23.45° (commonly rounded to +23.5°). This corresponds to the Sun being directly overhead near the Tropic of Cancer.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Solar declination δ is the angular position of the Sun north or south of the celestial equator. Over a year it varies approximately between +23.45° and −23.45° due to Earth's axial tilt. Around 21 June it is at its positive maximum.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

June solstice +23.5°, December solstice −23.5°.

**Important Exam Point**

Check hemisphere/sign convention if a problem specifies location/date differently.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Energy and Environment → Solar Energy → Solar Geometry .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

June solstice +23.5°, December solstice −23.5°.

### Common Mistake

Using 0°—that is the equinox value.

### Exam Tip

Check hemisphere/sign convention if a problem specifies location/date differently.

questions.title: Product Standards and Consistency
questions.stem: What does the term “Quality Control” mean in the context of Industrial Engineering and Management?
questions.quick: Quality control is the operational process of checking and controlling product/process output so specified standards are consistently met. It includes inspection, testing, statistical monitoring and corrective action.
formula: standard/specification → measure output → compare → correct process/product
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

Quality assurance focuses broadly on designing processes that prevent defects, while quality control emphasizes detecting/controlling variation in actual output. In industrial engineering, maintaining conformity, consistency and acceptable defect levels is therefore the central QC objective.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

QC = conformance and consistency.

**Important Exam Point**

Distinguish QC from finance, employee welfare and cost accounting.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Industrial Engineering and Management → Quality Management → Quality Control .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

QC = conformance and consistency.

### Common Mistake

Equating quality control only with final inspection; modern QC also monitors the process.

### Exam Tip

Distinguish QC from finance, employee welfare and cost accounting.

Large power station → very low earth resistance, ~0.5 Ω target in exam tables.

**Important Exam Point**

Resistance is one criterion; safe touch/step voltage is the deeper design objective.

This question sits in the revision path Electrical Laws, Standards and Energy Policy → Indian Standards → Earthing Design .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Large power station → very low earth resistance, ~0.5 Ω target in exam tables.

### Common Mistake

Applying a domestic installation earth-resistance rule to a large station grid.

### Exam Tip

Resistance is one criterion; safe touch/step voltage is the deeper design objective.

### Concept & Reasoning

A traction lift has several separate control and safety subsystems. The drive controller regulates normal motion, door operators manage doors, and indicators show floor status. The governor is specifically part of the overspeed protection chain: it detects excessive speed mechanically/electrically and initiates safety-gear action independent of normal control.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Governor = speed safety, not normal speed command.

**Important Exam Point**

In lift questions, separate normal controller functions from fail-safe mechanical protection.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → Vertical Transportation → Elevators .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Governor = speed safety, not normal speed command.

### Common Mistake

Calling the governor a door or lighting controller.

### Exam Tip

In lift questions, separate normal controller functions from fail-safe mechanical protection.

Emergency electrical systems prioritize functions needed for evacuation, fire detection, firefighting and critical safety. Fire pumps maintain hydrant/sprinkler pressure and fire alarms detect/annunciate emergencies. Their supply architecture typically includes dedicated feeders, automatic transfer and backup source provisions appropriate to the applicable code.

Fire detection + firefighting equipment = essential emergency loads.

Code details vary by occupancy/building height; keep the life-safety principle central.

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → Building Safety → Emergency Power .

Fire detection + firefighting equipment = essential emergency loads.

Treating convenience loads such as office workstations as equal to fire-protection loads.

Code details vary by occupancy/building height; keep the life-safety principle central.

questions.title: Condenser Heat Rejection
questions.stem: Which component in a central air conditioning system is responsible for removing heat from the refrigerant?
questions.quick: The condenser removes heat from the high-pressure refrigerant and rejects it to outdoor air or cooling water. During this process refrigerant changes from high-pressure vapor toward liquid before entering the expansion device.
formula: Evaporator → Compressor → Condenser → Expansion valve → Evaporator
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

In the vapor-compression cycle, the evaporator absorbs heat from the conditioned space, the compressor raises refrigerant pressure/temperature, the condenser rejects both absorbed heat and compressor work, and the expansion valve drops pressure before the evaporator.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Evaporator absorbs; condenser rejects.

**Important Exam Point**

Follow the heat direction rather than only refrigerant phase names.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → HVAC → Refrigeration Cycle .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Evaporator absorbs; condenser rejects.

### Common Mistake

Selecting evaporator because it is also a heat exchanger—it removes heat from the room, not from the refrigerant to outdoors.

### Exam Tip

Follow the heat direction rather than only refrigerant phase names.

questions.title: Cone of Protection Method
questions.stem: The 'cone of protection' method, specified in lightning protection standards, is used to determine the area protected by a
questions.quick: The cone-of-protection method estimates the zone shielded by a lightning air terminal/lightning rod. A geometric protective zone is drawn below/around the rod so equipment or building portions inside the zone are considered protected under that simplified method.

Lightning protection systems use air terminals to intercept strikes, down conductors to carry current and an earth-termination system to dissipate it. The protective-angle/cone concept is a geometrical method for positioning air terminals. Surge protective devices serve a different purpose: limiting transient overvoltage on electrical circuits.

Cone/protective angle → lightning rod coverage.

Do not confuse external lightning interception with internal surge protection.

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → Lightning Protection → Protection Zones .

Cone/protective angle → lightning rod coverage.

### Common Mistake

Choosing surge protector because it also relates to lightning; an SPD does not define a geometric cone over the building.

Do not confuse external lightning interception with internal surge protection.

To provide primary power to the entire building
To act as a backup power source during a grid outage
To power only the HVAC system

DG sets are sized according to essential/standby load demand, motor starting, transient voltage/frequency performance and code requirements. They are not normally operated solely to reduce daily energy bills unless a specific economic/peak-shaving strategy exists.

DG in buildings = standby power.

DG in buildings = standby power.

Differentiate standby generation from UPS: UPS supplies near-instant ride-through; DG provides longer-duration backup after start-up.

questions.title: RCCB
questions.stem: What is the primary function of an RCCB (Residual Current Circuit Breaker) in an electrical system?
options: To protect humans from electric shock due to earth faults
questions.quick: An RCCB protects people against dangerous earth-leakage/residual current by comparing the currents in live and neutral conductors. If the imbalance exceeds its trip threshold, it disconnects the circuit rapidly.
formula: If I_Δ ≥ trip threshold → RCCB trips
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

In normal operation the vector sum of currents through the RCCB's sensing core is approximately zero. An earth fault or shock path diverts some current outside the neutral return, producing residual current that triggers the device. An RCCB by itself does not provide overload/short-circuit protection; it is commonly coordinated with an MCB/fuse or replaced by an RCBO when both functions are needed.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

RCCB → residual/earth-leakage shock protection.

**Important Exam Point**

Remember RCCB ≠ MCB. MCB protects overcurrent; RCCB detects imbalance.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → Electrical Protection → Residual Current Protection .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

RCCB → residual/earth-leakage shock protection.

### Common Mistake

Selecting short-circuit protection as the primary RCCB function.

### Exam Tip

Remember RCCB ≠ MCB. MCB protects overcurrent; RCCB detects imbalance.

Multi-service monitoring/control → BMS.

Integration does not mean the BMS replaces every dedicated life-safety controller.

Multi-service monitoring/control → BMS.

The total height to which a pump can move water, accounting for friction losses
The volume of water it can move per minute

Head = energy per unit weight, expressed as metres of fluid.

Head = energy per unit weight, expressed as metres of fluid.

questions.stem: Wide−Bandgap (WBG) semiconductors like Gallium Nitride (GaN) are becoming popular in power electronics primarily because they offer _________

Better performance at very low temperatures
questions.quick: GaN wide-bandgap devices can switch at high frequency with low switching/conduction losses, enabling higher-efficiency and much smaller power converters than many conventional silicon implementations.

GaN/SiC → efficiency + high frequency + power density.

High-frequency capability only helps if layout, magnetics, EMI and thermal design are also engineered correctly.

options: It acts as an emergency brake
It balances the weight of the lift car and a portion of its load to save energy
It houses the lift control panel

questions.quick: The counterweight balances the lift car plus a designed fraction of rated load, reducing the traction motor torque and energy needed to move the system. It also helps maintain traction on the sheave.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

In a traction lift the car and counterweight are connected by ropes over a drive sheave. A common design balances approximately car mass plus 40–50% of rated payload, although exact balance factor varies. The motor then primarily handles the difference between car-side and counterweight-side weights plus losses/acceleration.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Counterweight reduces unbalanced load on the motor.

**Important Exam Point**

Counterweight is not the emergency brake; safety gear/governor handle overspeed protection.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → Vertical Transportation → Traction Elevators .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Counterweight reduces unbalanced load on the motor.

### Common Mistake

Assuming it exactly equals the fully loaded car weight.

### Exam Tip

Counterweight is not the emergency brake; safety gear/governor handle overspeed protection.

questions.title: Inductive Wireless Charging
questions.stem: The principle of operation for most common wireless charging pads for mobile devices is based on
questions.quick: Most common phone charging pads transfer energy by electromagnetic induction between a transmitter coil in the pad and a receiver coil in the device, often with resonant compensation to improve coupling and efficiency.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

An alternating current in the primary coil produces a time-varying magnetic flux. The receiver coil intercepts part of that flux, inducing an emf according to Faraday's law. Power electronics then rectify/regulate the received energy for battery charging.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Wireless charging pad → coupled coils → induction.

**Important Exam Point**

Alignment and coil separation strongly affect coupling coefficient and efficiency.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Building Electrical Services → Emerging Electrical Technologies → Wireless Power Transfer .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Wireless charging pad → coupled coils → induction.

### Common Mistake

Selecting static electricity; charging power is transferred by time-varying magnetic fields.

### Exam Tip

Alignment and coil separation strongly affect coupling coefficient and efficiency.

questions.title: AC and DC Measurement by Moving-Iron Instrument
questions.stem: નીચેનામાંથી કયા પ્રકારના ઇન્સ્ટ્રુમેન્ટનો ઉપયોગ AC અને DC બંને માપન માટે થઈ શકે છે?
questions.quick: Moving-iron instrument AC અને DC બંને માપી શકે છે કારણ કે તેનું deflecting torque current ના square પર આધારિત છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ B — Moving iron instrument**

### Explanation

Moving-iron instrument માં deflecting torque current ના square પર આધારિત હોય છે. તેથી current ની દિશા બદલાય તો પણ torque ની દિશા બદલાતી નથી. આ કારણથી તે DC અને AC બંને માપી શકે છે.

### Key Concept

કારણનો મૂળ મુદ્દો એ છે કે relation માં I² આવે છે, એટલે polarity બદલાય છતાં deflection direction બદલાતી નથી.

### Formula

**Td ∝ I²**

### Exam Point

ઝડપી યાદ: MI → AC & DC, PMMC → DC, Induction → AC.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

I² relation → AC અને DC બંને માટે same deflection direction.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Induction instrument AC માટે છે. સામાન્ય PMMC/moving-coil DC માટે છે. આ પ્રશ્નમાં standard general-purpose AC/DC instrument તરીકે Moving iron intended answer છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

PMMC accurate છે, પણ ordinary PMMC સીધું AC માપતું નથી.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

MI એ standard AC/DC measuring instrument છે.

questions.title: Wattmeter Readings from Total Power and Power Factor
questions.stem: For a balanced three phase, three wire system with input power of 10 kW at 0.9 power factor, the readings on both wattmeter are _________ respectively
questions.quick: For a balanced three-phase load, W₁+W₂=P=10 kW and tanφ=√3(W₁−W₂)/(W₁+W₂). With cosφ=0.9, φ≈25.84°; solving gives W₁≈6.40 kW and W₂≈3.60 kW, nearest to 6350 W and 3650 W.
questions.detailed:
### Concept & Reasoning

The two-wattmeter method measures total three-phase real power in a 3-wire system. Power factor determines the difference between readings. At unity power factor both readings are equal; as lag angle increases, one reading rises and the other falls. Here the relatively high 0.9 pf gives two positive readings with a modest difference.

### How to Solve It in the Exam

Use sum for total power, difference for power factor.

**Important Exam Point**

Check that W₁+W₂ is approximately 10 kW for any candidate.

### Related Revision Path

This question sits in the revision path Electrical Measurements → Three-Phase Circuits → Two-Wattmeter Method .
questions.extra:
### Quick Trick

Use sum for total power, difference for power factor.

### Common Mistake

Choosing 5 kW,5 kW; equal readings imply unity power factor, not 0.9.

### Exam Tip

Check that W₁+W₂ is approximately 10 kW for any candidate.

exam.name: સુપરવાઇઝર ઇન્સ્ટ્રક્ટર ઇલેક્ટ્રિકલ ગ્રુપ

questions.title: Resonance in Vibrating Reed Frequency Meter
questions.stem: એક vibrating reed frequency meter માં 45 Hz થી 55 Hz સુધી 1 Hz step માં tune કરેલી reeds છે. જો 50 Hz frequency લાગુ કરવામાં આવે, તો કઈ reed maximum amplitude સાથે vibrate કરશે?
questions.quick: જે reed ની natural frequency applied frequency જેટલી હોય તે resonance માં જઈ સૌથી વધુ vibrate કરે છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ A — 50 Hz પર tune કરેલી reed**

### Explanation

દરેક reed ની પોતાની natural frequency હોય છે. જ્યારે applied frequency અને reed ની natural frequency સમાન થાય ત્યારે resonance થાય છે. Resonance પર vibration amplitude maximum થાય છે. તેથી 50 Hz reed સૌથી વધુ vibrate કરશે.

### Key Concept

Vibrating-reed meter માં supply frequency ઓળખવા માટે કઈ reed resonance માં જાય છે તે જોવામાં આવે છે.

### Formula

**freed = fsupply**

### Exam Point

Same frequency → resonance → maximum amplitude.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Exact frequency match પર amplitude સૌથી વધુ થાય છે.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

45 Hz, 48 Hz અને 53 Hz reeds resonance પર નથી, તેથી તેમનું amplitude ઓછું રહેશે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Exact 50 Hz reed હાજર હોય ત્યારે 48 Hz અથવા 53 Hz પસંદ ન કરવી.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

નજીકની reed નહીં, resonant reed શોધવી.

questions.title: Function of Control Rods
questions.stem: ન્યુક્લિયર reactor માં fission પ્રક્રિયાને નિયંત્રિત કરવા અને reactor ને shut down કરવા માટે વધારાના neutrons absorb કરતું component કયું છે?
questions.quick: Control rods વધારાના neutrons absorb કરીને chain reaction નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ B — Control rods**

### Explanation

Fission reaction ચાલુ રહે છે કારણ કે બહાર પડતા neutrons વધુ fission કરાવે છે. Control rods neutron-absorbing material થી બને છે. Rods વધારે અંદર નાખીએ ત્યારે તે વધુ neutrons absorb કરે છે, reaction rate ઘટે છે અને reactor shut down પણ થઈ શકે છે.

### Key Concept

Fuel rods fuel આપે છે, moderator neutrons ધીમા કરે છે અને coolant heat દૂર કરે છે. Control માટે neutron absorption નું કામ control rods કરે છે.

### Exam Point

Neutron absorb → Control rods. Neutron slow → Moderator.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Control rods chain reaction control કરે છે.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Fuel rods માં fissile fuel હોય છે. Moderator neutrons ની speed ઘટાડે છે. Coolant pumps heat દૂર કરવા coolant circulate કરે છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Moderator અને control rods ને એક સમાન ન માનવું.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Absorb = control, slow = moderator.

questions.title: Deflecting Torque Equation of MI Instrument
questions.stem: Moving-iron instrument માં deflecting torque માટેનું સાચું equation કયું છે?
questions.quick: Moving-iron instrument માટે stored magnetic energy ½LI² છે. Deflection angle પ્રમાણે તેનું differentiation કરતાં torque મળે છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ B — Td = ½ I² (dL/dθ)**

### Explanation

Moving-iron instrument માં moving iron ની position બદલાતાં inductance બદલાય છે. Coil માં stored magnetic energy ½LI² છે. આ energy નો deflection angle θ મુજબ change mechanical torque આપે છે. તેથી T_d = ½I²(dL/dθ) સાચું equation છે.

### Key Concept

સાચા relation માં I² અને dL/dθ બંને આવવા જોઈએ.

### Formula

**W = ½LI²
Td = ½I²(dL/dθ)**

### Exam Point

જો I² ન હોય તો moving-iron instrument માટે equation પૂર્ણ નથી.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Moving-iron torque relation માં I² આવશ્યક છે.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

I² વગરના options moving iron instrument ના magnetic-energy torque relation ને દર્શાવતા નથી.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

સૌથી સામાન્ય ભૂલ current પર square છોડવાની છે.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

MI torque = ½ × I² × inductance નો rate of change.

concept.name: Effect of Coil Length on Inductance

exam.name: સુપરવાઇઝર ઇન્સ્ટ્રક્ટર ઇલેક્ટ્રિકલ ગ્રુપ

questions.title: Effect of Coil Length on Inductance
questions.stem: જો coil ની લંબાઈ વધારવામાં આવે, તો તેના inductance પર શું અસર થાય છે?
questions.quick: Solenoid માટે અન્ય factors constant હોય ત્યારે inductance length ના inverse proportion માં હોય છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ D — ઘટે છે**

### Explanation

Coil અથવા solenoid નું inductance permeability, number of turns, cross-sectional area અને length પર આધારિત છે. જો μ, N અને A constant હોય, તો length વધારવાથી magnetic reluctance વધે છે અને inductance ઘટે છે. તેથી સાચો જવાબ 'ઘટે છે' છે.

### Key Concept

મુખ્ય proportionality length સાથે inverse છે.

### Formula

**L = μN²A / l**

### Exam Point

Length ↑ → Inductance ↓.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

L ∝ 1/l

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Inductance unchanged અથવા infinite થતું નથી. N, μ અથવા A બદલાય તો અલગ અસર થઈ શકે છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Coil length વધે એટલે turns વધ્યા જ છે એવું માનવું નહીં.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Formula માં N² numerator માં અને l denominator માં છે.

questions.title: Condition for Maximum Efficiency
questions.stem: Two-winding transformer મહત્તમ efficiency પર ત્યારે કામ કરે છે જ્યારે ____________.
questions.quick: મહત્તમ efficiency તે load પર થાય છે જ્યાં variable copper loss અને constant iron loss સમાન થાય છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ C — Copper loss = iron loss**

### Explanation

Constant supply voltage અને frequency પર transformer નું iron loss લગભગ constant રહે છે. Copper loss load current સાથે બદલાય છે અને load વધે તેમ વધે છે. Transformer ની efficiency ત્યારે maximum થાય છે જ્યારે variable copper loss, iron loss જેટલું થાય.

### Key Concept

આ transformer maximum efficiency ની standard condition છે.

### Formula

**Maximum efficiency પર:
Pcu = Piron**

### Exam Point

Variable loss = constant loss.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Maximum η → copper loss = iron loss.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Minimum regulation maximum efficiency ની condition નથી. Hysteresis અને eddy-current બંને મળીને core loss બને છે. Primary-secondary resistance સમાન હોવી જરૂરી નથી.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Minimum regulation maximum efficiency ની condition નથી.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

આ condition ને maximum power transfer સાથે mix ન કરવી.

questions.title: Pyrolysis of Biomass
questions.stem: Biomass નું high temperature પર oxygen ની ગેરહાજરીમાં થતું thermochemical decomposition કઈ પ્રક્રિયા કહેવાય?
questions.quick: Pyrolysis એ oxygen વગર biomass નું thermal decomposition છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ A — Pyrolysis**

### Explanation

Pyrolysis માં biomass ને high temperature પર ગરમ કરવામાં આવે છે, પરંતુ સામાન્ય oxygen supply આપવામાં આવતી નથી. તેથી તે સીધું combustion કરતું નથી, પરંતુ thermal decomposition દ્વારા char, bio-oil અને gas જેવા products આપે છે.

### Key Concept

'High temperature' અને 'absence of oxygen' આ બંને શબ્દો સીધા pyrolysis બતાવે છે.

### Exam Point

No oxygen + heat = pyrolysis.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

No O₂ + heat → pyrolysis.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Gasification માં limited oxygen/steam હોય છે. Digestion biological process છે. Combustion માટે oxygen જરૂરી છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Pyrolysis ને combustion સાથે confuse ન કરવું.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Gasification માં limited oxidant હોય છે; pyrolysis માં normal oxygen supply નથી.

questions.title: Complex Impedance of Series RLC Circuit
questions.stem: AC supply સાથે જોડાયેલા series R-L-C circuit માં total impedance કયું છે?
questions.quick: Series circuit માં R, +jX_L અને −jX_C add થાય છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ B — Z = R + j(XL − XC) Ω**

### Explanation

Series RLC circuit માં resistor real part R આપે છે. Inductor +jX_L આપે છે અને capacitor −jX_C આપે છે. ત્રણેયને add કરતાં Z = R + j(X_L − X_C) મળે છે.

### Key Concept

Inductive reactance અને capacitive reactance imaginary axis પર opposite direction માં કાર્ય કરે છે.

### Formula

**Z = R + j(XL − XC)
|Z| = √[R² + (XL − XC)²]**

### Exam Point

Inductor → +jX_L, Capacitor → −jX_C.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Series RLC → R + jX_L − jX_C

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Option A અને C માં એક reactance missing છે. Option D માં R missing છે અને X_L, X_C ને same sign થી add કર્યા છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

ઘણા વિદ્યાર્થીઓ R real term ભૂલી જાય છે.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

X_L અને X_C ને same sign થી add ન કરવા.

questions.title: Impedance-based Transmission Line Protection
questions.stem: Impedance measurement ના આધારે transmission line protection માટે કયો relay ઉપયોગ થાય છે?
questions.quick: Distance relay relay location પરથી apparent impedance, સામાન્ય રીતે V/I, માપે છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ B — Distance relay**

### Explanation

Transmission line નું impedance તેની length સાથે proportional હોય છે. Distance relay voltage અને current પરથી apparent impedance માપે છે. જો measured impedance relay setting ની range માં આવે, તો relay operate થાય છે. તેથી impedance-based line protection માટે distance relay ઉપયોગ થાય છે.

### Key Concept

'Impedance' આ પ્રશ્નનો મુખ્ય clue છે.

### Formula

**Zseen = V / I**

### Exam Point

Line distance line impedance પરથી અંદાજવામાં આવે છે.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Impedance-based protection → distance relay.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Overcurrent relay current magnitude પર operate કરે છે. Earth-fault relay earth fault detect કરે છે. Thermal relay overheating/overload માટે છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Fault current વધારે હોય એટલે હંમેશા overcurrent relay પસંદ ન કરવો.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Overcurrent માત્ર current જુએ છે; distance relay apparent impedance જુએ છે.

exam.name: સુપરવાઇઝર ઇન્સ્ટ્રક્ટર ઇલેક્ટ્રિકલ ગ્રુપ

questions.title: Fast Recovery and Low Forward Drop of Schottky Diode
questions.stem: Schottky diode માં __________ recovery time અને __________ forward-voltage drop હોય છે.
questions.quick: Schottky diode majority-carrier device હોવાથી તેની switching ઝડપી અને forward drop ઓછો હોય છે.
questions.detailed:
### Correct Answer

**વિકલ્પ A — ખૂબ ઝડપી recovery time અને ઓછો forward-voltage drop**

### Explanation

Schottky diode metal-semiconductor device છે અને તેમાં conduction મુખ્યત્વે majority carriers દ્વારા થાય છે. Charge storage બહુ ઓછું હોવાથી reverse recovery ખૂબ ઝડપી હોય છે. સામાન્ય silicon PN diodeની સરખામણીએ તેનો forward-voltage drop પણ ઓછો હોય છે.

### Key Concept

Schottky diode ના બે મુખ્ય લાભ છે: fast switching અને low forward drop.

### Formula

**Typical VF ≈ 0.2–0.4 V**

### Exam Point

ઝડપી યાદ: FAST + LOW DROP.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Schottky → FAST + LOW DROP

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

બાકીના options slow recovery અથવા high forward drop બતાવે છે, જે Schottky diode ના મુખ્ય advantages ના opposite છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

દરેક diode નો forward drop સમાન હોય છે એવું માનવું નહીં.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

તેની સરખામણી normal silicon PN diode સાથે કરો.

questions.title: Electrical Insulation of PVC Conduit
questions.stem: PVC નળી (PVC conduit/pipe) ને ધાતુની નળી (metallic conduit)થી અલગ પાડતો કયો વિદ્યુત ગુણધર્મ છે?
options: ધાતુની નળીનો ઘરની અંદર (indoor) ઉપયોગ કરી શકાતો નથી.
ધાતુની નળી PVC નળી કરતાં વજનમાં હલકી હોય છે.
PVC નળી વિદ્યુતનું વહન કરતી નથી.
PVC નળીને સાઇટ પર વાળવી મુશ્કેલ છે.
questions.quick: PVC વિદ્યુત અવાહક (electrical insulator) છે, જ્યારે ધાતુની નળી વિદ્યુતવાહક હોય છે.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ C — PVC નળી વિદ્યુતનું વહન કરતી નથી.**

### સમજૂતી

PVC એક વિદ્યુત અવાહક (electrical insulator) પદાર્થ છે, તેથી PVC નળી વિદ્યુત પ્રવાહ માટે વાહક માર્ગ આપતી નથી. તેની સામે ધાતુની નળી વિદ્યુતવાહક હોય છે અને સલામતી માટે તેને યોગ્ય રીતે બોન્ડિંગ/અર્થિંગ કરવું પડે છે. પ્રશ્નમાં ખાસ કરીને **વિદ્યુત ગુણધર્મ**  પૂછવામાં આવ્યો હોવાથી non-conductivity મુખ્ય તફાવત છે.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

PVC નળી વિદ્યુત ઇન્સ્યુલેશન અને કાટ સામે સારો પ્રતિકાર આપે છે; ધાતુની નળી વધારે યાંત્રિક સુરક્ષા આપે છે પરંતુ વિદ્યુતવાહક છે.

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

“વિદ્યુત ગુણધર્મ” શબ્દ દેખાય તો વજન કે વાળવાની સરળતા નહીં, conductivity/insulation પર ધ્યાન આપો.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

વિદ્યુત ગુણધર્મ → વાહકતા → PVC અવાહક છે.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

ધાતુની નળીનો indoor ઉપયોગ થઈ શકે છે; તે સામાન્ય રીતે PVC કરતાં ભારે હોય છે; અને PVC નળી rigid metal conduit કરતાં સામાન્ય રીતે વધુ સરળતાથી વાળી/આકાર આપી શકાય છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

વજન અથવા bendability જેવા યાંત્રિક તફાવતને સાચો જવાબ માનવો.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

પ્રશ્નમાં “વિદ્યુત ગુણધર્મ” પૂછાયો હોય ત્યારે conductivity/insulation ને પ્રાથમિકતા આપો.

questions.title: Mutual Inductance Measurement using Carey Foster Bridge
questions.stem: કેરી ફોસ્ટર બ્રિજ (Carey Foster Bridge) નો ઉપયોગ કરીને મ્યુચ્યુઅલ ઇન્ડક્ટન્સ (Mutual Inductance) માપવા માટે નીચેમાંથી શાની જરૂર પડે છે?
options: પરસ્પર ચુંબકીય જોડાણ ધરાવતા બે ઇન્ડક્ટર (two inductors with mutual coupling)
એક DC પાવર સોર્સ (DC power source)
દરેક આર્મમાં એક કેપેસિટર (a capacitor in each arm)
questions.quick: મ્યુચ્યુઅલ ઇન્ડક્ટન્સ માટે બે ઇન્ડક્ટર વચ્ચે ચુંબકીય જોડાણ (magnetic coupling) આવશ્યક છે.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ A — પરસ્પર ચુંબકીય જોડાણ ધરાવતા બે ઇન્ડક્ટર**

### સમજૂતી

મ્યુચ્યુઅલ ઇન્ડક્ટન્સ ત્યારે જ બને છે જ્યારે એક કોઇલ દ્વારા ઉત્પન્ન થયેલા ચુંબકીય ફ્લક્સનો અમુક ભાગ બીજી કોઇલ સાથે લિંક થાય. તેથી mutual inductance માપવા માટેના બ્રિજ વ્યવસ્થામાં પરસ્પર ચુંબકીય રીતે જોડાયેલા બે ઇન્ડક્ટર/વાઇન્ડિંગ આવશ્યક છે. આ coupling દ્વારા જ M મળે છે.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

Coupling coefficient શૂન્ય હોય તો mutual inductance પણ શૂન્ય હોય છે.

### સૂત્ર

**M = k√(L₁L₂)**

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

“Mutual inductance” શબ્દ દેખાય એટલે તરત coupled coils યાદ કરો.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Mutual inductance → બે magnetically coupled coils.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

માત્ર DC source પૂરતું નથી; દરેક armમાં capacitor હોવો આવશ્યક નથી; અને જરૂરી મૂળ ઘટક અલગ transformer નહીં પરંતુ પરસ્પર coupled બે inductors છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Transformerમાં પણ coupled windings હોય છે એ કારણે option D પસંદ કરી દેવું; બ્રિજ માટે જરૂરી ચોક્કસ શરત બે inductors વચ્ચે mutual coupling છે.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Mutual inductanceના પ્રશ્નમાં સૌપ્રથમ coupled windings ઓળખો.

questions.title: Directional Response of Relay
questions.stem: નીચેના વિકલ્પોમાંથી કઈ લાક્ષણિકતા દિશાત્મક રિલે (Directional Relay) ને બિન-દિશાત્મક રિલે (Non-directional Relay)થી અલગ પાડે છે?
options: દિશાત્મક રિલે માત્ર ઉચ્ચ વોલ્ટેજ પર જ કાર્ય કરે છે.
દિશાત્મક રિલે આવૃત્તિ (frequency)માં ફેરફાર પર પ્રતિક્રિયા આપે છે.
દિશાત્મક રિલે વિદ્યુતપ્રવાહના વહનની દિશા પર પ્રતિક્રિયા આપે છે.
દિશાત્મક રિલે વિદ્યુતપ્રવાહની તીવ્રતાથી સંપૂર્ણપણે સ્વતંત્ર રીતે કાર્ય કરે છે.
questions.quick: Directional relay fault current/power flow આગળની કે પાછળની દિશામાં છે તે ઓળખી શકે છે.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ C — દિશાત્મક રિલે વિદ્યુતપ્રવાહના વહનની દિશા પર પ્રતિક્રિયા આપે છે.**

### સમજૂતી

Directional relayમાં directional element હોય છે, જે current અને સામાન્ય રીતે voltage જેવા polarizing quantity વચ્ચેના phase relation પરથી fault current અથવા power flowની દિશા નક્કી કરે છે. તેથી તે forward fault અને reverse faultને અલગ ઓળખી શકે છે. Non-directional relayમાં આ પ્રકારનું direction discrimination હોતું નથી.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

Directional protection માટે માત્ર “કેટલો current?” નહીં, પરંતુ “કઈ દિશામાં?” પણ મહત્વનું છે.

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

“Directional” શબ્દનો સીધો અર્થ forward/reverse direction discrimination છે.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Directional relay → magnitude સાથે direction પણ ઓળખે છે.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

તે માત્ર high voltage પર જ કાર્ય કરતું નથી, frequency relay નથી, અને directional overcurrent protectionમાં current magnitude પણ મહત્વપૂર્ણ રહે છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Directional relay current magnitudeથી સંપૂર્ણપણે સ્વતંત્ર હોય છે એવું માનવું.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

“Directional” શબ્દને જ clue માનો: forward કે reverse?

questions.title: Full-load Torque vs Maximum Torque
questions.stem: સ્થિર કામગીરી માટે 3-ફેઝ ઇન્ડક્શન મોટરમાં પૂર્ણ-લોડ ટોર્ક (Full-load Torque) અને મહત્તમ ટોર્ક (Maximum Torque)નો ગુણોત્તર સામાન્ય રીતે કેટલો હોય છે?
questions.quick: સ્થિર સામાન્ય કામગીરીમાં full-load torque, breakdown/maximum torque કરતાં ઓછો હોય છે; તેથી T_FL/T_max < 1.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ C — 1 કરતાં ઓછો**

### સમજૂતી

ઇન્ડક્શન મોટરનો maximum torque એ breakdown અથવા pull-out torque છે. Rated full-load operating point torque-slip characteristicના stable ભાગમાં maximum-torque point પહેલાં આવે છે. તેથી full-load torque હંમેશા maximum torque કરતાં ઓછો રહે છે.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

સામાન્ય કામગીરી માટે breakdown torque સુધી સુરક્ષિત torque margin રહેવું જરૂરી છે.

### સૂત્ર

**T/Tmax = 2 / [(s/sm) + (sm/s)]**

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

T_FL < T_max હોવાથી T_FL/T_max < 1.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Maximum torque upper limit છે → full-load torque તેના કરતાં ઓછો જ રહેશે.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

Torque ratio slipના બમણા જેટલો નથી; maximum torqueની વ્યાખ્યા પ્રમાણે ratio 1થી મોટો થઈ શકતો નથી; અને ratio = 1 માત્ર maximum-torque point પર થાય છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Torque ratioને slip સાથે ગૂંચવવું અથવા full-load torque maximum torque જેટલો/વધારે માની લેવો.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Breakdown torqueને stable operating regionની upper torque limit તરીકે યાદ રાખો.

questions.title: Desirable Properties of Conductor Material
questions.stem: નીચેમાંથી કયું પાવર ટ્રાન્સમિશનમાં વપરાતા કન્ડક્ટર મટિરિયલ (conductor material)નું ઇચ્છનીય ગુણધર્મ નથી?
questions.quick: ટ્રાન્સમિશન કન્ડક્ટર શક્ય તેટલો હલકો હોવો ઇચ્છનીય છે; તેથી ઉચ્ચ વજન ઇચ્છનીય ગુણધર્મ નથી.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ A — ઉચ્ચ વજન**

### સમજૂતી

Overhead transmission conductorમાં ઓછા વિદ્યુત નુકસાન માટે high electrical conductivity, યાંત્રિક તાણ સહન કરવા high tensile strength અને આર્થિક સ્થાપન માટે low cost ઇચ્છનીય છે. ઓછું વજન પણ મહત્વનું છે કારણ કે તે sag અને support પરનો mechanical load ઘટાડે છે. તેથી **ઉચ્ચ વજન**  ઇચ્છનીય ગુણધર્મ નથી.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

સારો conductor material: high conductivity + high strength + low weight + reasonable cost.

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

High tensile strength ઇચ્છનીય છે, પરંતુ high weight ઇચ્છનીય નથી.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

સારો conductor → વધુ conductivity, વધુ strength, ઓછું weight, ઓછો cost.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

ઓછો ખર્ચ, high tensile strength અને high electrical conductivity ત્રણેય transmission conductor માટે ઇચ્છનીય છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

‘High’ શબ્દ ધરાવતા બધા ગુણધર્મ સારા જ હોય એવું માનવું; high weight sag અને support loading વધારે છે.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Overhead lineમાં electrical performance સાથે mechanical load પણ વિચારવો.

questions.title: Average Power in Pure Capacitive Circuit
questions.stem: માત્ર કેપેસિટર ધરાવતા પરિપથ (Pure Capacitive Circuit)માં AC સપ્લાયમાંથી લેવાતી સરેરાશ વાસ્તવિક શક્તિ (average real power) કેટલી હોય છે?
questions.quick: Pure capacitorમાં current, voltageથી 90° આગળ હોય છે; તેથી P_avg = VI cos90° = 0.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ D — શૂન્ય**

### સમજૂતી

Pure capacitive circuitમાં current, voltage કરતાં 90° આગળ (lead) હોય છે. Capacitor એક ભાગના ચક્રમાં electric fieldમાં energy સંગ્રહે છે અને બીજા ભાગમાં એ energy supplyને પરત આપે છે. તેથી instantaneous power ક્યારેક positive અને ક્યારેક negative હોય છે, અને સંપૂર્ણ cycle પર average real power શૂન્ય બને છે.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

Pure capacitor reactive power સાથે જોડાયેલ છે, પરંતુ average real power વાપરતો નથી.

### સૂત્ર

**Pavg = VI cosφ = VI cos90° = 0**

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

Pure L અથવા Pure C → |φ| = 90° → power factor = 0 → average real power = 0.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Pure C → I, V કરતાં 90° lead કરે → cos90° = 0.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

સરેરાશ real power ઋણ, એક કે અનંત નથી; એક સંપૂર્ણ cycleમાં લીધેલી અને પરત આપેલી energyનું net પરિણામ શૂન્ય થાય છે.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

સરેરાશ શક્તિ શૂન્ય હોવાથી current પણ શૂન્ય હશે એવું માનવું.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

Zero average powerનો અર્થ zero current નથી; capacitor reactive current લઈ શકે છે.

questions.title: Repulsion-type MI Instrument Construction
questions.stem: અપાકર્ષણ-પ્રકાર (Repulsion-type)ના મૂવિંગ આયર્ન (MI) ઇન્સ્ટ્રુમેન્ટમાં સોફ્ટ આયર્નના કેટલા ટુકડા/વેન (pieces/vanes) વપરાય છે?
questions.quick: Repulsion-type MI instrumentમાં બે soft-iron pieces હોય છે—એક fixed અને એક moving.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ A — બે**

### સમજૂતી

Repulsion-type moving-iron instrumentમાં current-carrying coilના magnetic fieldમાં બે soft-iron vane/piece રાખવામાં આવે છે. તેમાં એક fixed અને બીજું moving હોય છે. બંનેમાં સમાન polarityનું magnetization થતાં તેઓ એકબીજાને repel કરે છે અને pointer deflection ઉત્પન્ન થાય છે.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

Repulsion માટે pair જરૂરી છે: એક fixed iron + એક moving iron.

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

Repulsion-type MI → 2 iron pieces. Attraction-type MI સાથે તેને ગૂંચવશો નહીં.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

Repulsion માટે pair જોઈએ → 1 fixed + 1 moving = 2.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

એક iron pieceથી repulsion-type રચના બનતી નથી; standard instrumentમાં ત્રણ કે ચાર pieces વપરાતા નથી.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Repulsion-type અને attraction-type MI instrument વચ્ચે ગૂંચવણ કરવી.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

‘Repulsion’ શબ્દને બે similarly magnetized iron vanes સાથે જોડીને યાદ રાખો.

questions.title: Replacement of IER 1956 by CEA Regulations 2010
questions.stem: ભારતીય વીજળી નિયમો (Indian Electricity Rules), 1956 ને નીચેમાંથી કયા નિયમન દ્વારા બદલવામાં આવ્યા હતા?
questions.quick: Indian Electricity Rules, 1956ના safety provisionsને 2010માં CEAના safety and electric-supply regulations દ્વારા બદલી દેવામાં આવ્યા.
questions.detailed:
### સાચો જવાબ

**વિકલ્પ A — Central Electricity Authority Regulations (CEAR), 2010**

### સમજૂતી

Indian Electricity Rules, 1956 જૂના કાનૂની માળખાનો ભાગ હતા. Electricity Act, 2003 હેઠળ Central Electricity Authorityએ **Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010**  જાહેર કર્યા. આ regulations લાગુ થતાં 1956ના સંબંધિત safety provisions repealed/replaced થયા.

### મુખ્ય ખ્યાલ

પરીક્ષા માટે ક્રમ યાદ રાખો: IER 1956 → Electricity Act 2003 framework → CEA Safety Regulations 2010.

### પરીક્ષા મુદ્દો

Generic “power act” કરતાં CEA safety regulationsનું ચોક્કસ નામ મહત્વનું છે.
questions.extra:
### ઝડપી ટ્રિક

IER 1956 → CEA Safety Regulations 2010.

### બીજા વિકલ્પો ખોટા કેમ છે

બાકીના વિકલ્પો Indian Electricity Rules, 1956ના safety provisionsને બદલનાર નિયમન નથી.

### સામાન્ય ભૂલ

Electricity Act, 2003 અને તેના હેઠળ બનાવાયેલા ચોક્કસ CEA Regulationsને એક જ વસ્તુ માનવી.

### પરીક્ષા ટિપ

પૂર્ણ નામ યાદ રાખો: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010.
